blocks.text: CALASIAO, PANGASINAN – A 29-year-old woman died while two others, including a two-year-old child, were injured after their tricycle was hit by a pickup truck in Sta. Barbara town in this province on Saturday. Police said the tricycle, driven by a 24-year-old security guard, was hit from behind by a pickup truck driven by a 38-year-old sales agent around 4 a.m. in Barangay Tebag West. READ: Elderly stroke victim dies in tricycle-truck collision in Quezon The impact caused the tricycle to lose control and spin several times before stopping along the outer lane of the road.
